description: This file contains helper functions for managing relationships between modules in SuiteCRM, including retrieving relationship properties, querying relationships, and handling linked records. It also includes error handling using SoapError and some utility functions.

methods.name: check_for_relationship
methods.description: Checks if a relationship exists for a given module and returns the table name if found.

methods.name: retrieve_relationships_properties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of relationships between two modules from the database.

methods.name: retrieve_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves all viewable relationships between two modules, with support for filtering and pagination.

methods.name: retrieve_modified_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves relationships between modules that have been modified within a date range, with optional field selection.

methods.name: server_save_relationships
methods.description: Saves a list of relationship records to the database, handling inserts and updates within a date range.

methods.name: get_from_statement
methods.description: Extracts and returns the FROM clause from a given SQL query string.

methods.name: retrieve_relationship_query
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query string to retrieve relationship data between modules.

methods.name: get_module_link_field
methods.description: Returns the link field name between two modules if a relationship exists.

methods.name: get_linked_records
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of records linked to a given record in another module via their relationship.
